metadata.title: Desi Chicken offered to tribal deity | बलि का मुर्गा कैसे पकता है
metadata.description: Tribal sacrifice chicken or goat to make their deity happy. In the tribal tradition in every puja the an animal is sacrificed by the Adivasis. We recently visited a religious place where tribal and non tribal both come after their wish is fulfilled. People come here to thank the deity with the sacrifice of goat or chicken.
